title: Temporary Works Permit
name: Temporary Works Permit
description: Temporary works permit and hold-point record covering design, installation, loading/use, monitoring and striking/removal.

sections.title: DESIGN BRIEF, DESIGN AND CHECK
items: Temporary works are recorded on the register
Design brief defines purpose, loads and constraints
Designer is competent and has the current brief
Design is checked to the project procedure
Design assumptions and hold points are stated
Current approved drawings are available
Interfaces with permanent and temporary works are coordinated

fields.label: Design Drawing / Calculation References and Revisions

sections.title: INSTALLATION AND PRE-LOAD INSPECTION
items: Installed to latest approved design
Materials and components are suitable
Foundations and supports are suitable
Bracing and stability measures are complete
No unapproved deviations have been made
Installation is inspected before loading
Defects or departures are resolved or accepted

sections.title: PERMIT TO LOAD / USE
items: Required hold points are released
TWC confirms temporary works are ready
Load and use restrictions are communicated
Load signage / physical restrictions are in place where needed
Monitoring requirements during use are defined

fields.label: Permit to Load / Use Authorised By (TWC or delegated competent person)
Permit to Load / Use Date / Time

sections.title: MONITORING AND CHANGE CONTROL
items: Inspection and monitoring frequencies are defined
Re-inspection follows events affecting stability
No design or loading change occurs without approval
Design changes use controlled revisions
Unexpected movement or defects trigger stop-work and review

sections.title: PERMIT TO STRIKE AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Permanent works meet prerequisites before removal
Strike sequence and residual supports are confirmed
Loads are transferred in approved sequence
Dismantling team is briefed
Temporary works are not removed prematurely
Register and design records are updated

fields.label: Evidence Prerequisites for Striking Are Met
Permit to Strike / Remove Authorised By
